# Revision results (generated by experiments/make_summary.py)

All numbers come from the scripts in `experiments/`. VAL is the regenerated Table-4 suite (seed 42), used for development only; TEST-A (fresh, same design), TEST-B (balanced, degree-matched) and PLANTED (chi known) are held out. DSATUR = the paper's `sat*10000 + deg`. Paired tests: bootstrap 95% CI, Wilcoxon + Holm, TOST with delta = 0.10 colours.

## S0.1 Equivalence of the new evaluator

A = original code vs incremental (identical colour of every vertex); B = independent full-argmax reference vs incremental; C = numba engine vs exact engine (colour counts).
